# Portfolio API

> A public, read-only JSON API for Touhidul Alam Seyam's published portfolio data.

- [OpenAPI](https://seyamalam.vercel.app/openapi.json)
- [Profile](https://seyamalam.vercel.app/api/v1/profile)
- [Projects](https://seyamalam.vercel.app/api/v1/projects)
- [Research](https://seyamalam.vercel.app/api/v1/research)
- [Developer documentation](https://seyamalam.vercel.app/developers)

The API needs no authentication. It has no write operations, user accounts, pagination, background jobs, billing, or webhooks.
